Here in Singida the rains are not reliable, and this plot grows a mix of crops, not maize where fertilizer pays back well. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer on an "other" crop that I mostly grow for the family, but I do keep a few animals so I will spread some manure before planting. I will use seed I saved from last season — improved seed for this kind of crop is hard to find at the shops here, and costly. My wife and I will do most of the work by hand hoe, and I will hire a few people for land clearing and weeding when the rains come hard.
